# AStack: Make AI agents prove their work on your running app > **Don't trust the agent. Trust the evidence.**

AStack is a Google Antigravity plugin that makes the agent prove its work. You give [`/astack-mode`](./skills/astack-mode/SKILL.md) a goal. It picks a playbook, runs the skills that playbook needs, cleans the diff, and checks the result on your running app before it reports done. AStack takes inspiration from Lauren Tan's [`pstack`](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack) for empirical verification playbooks and Garry Tan's [`gstack`](https://github.com/garrytan/gstack) for structured review gates, and builds those ideas natively for Google Antigravity. AStack has 65 skills, 26 playbooks, 24 engineering principles, 4 custom agents, 1 routing rule, 9 lifecycle hooks (3 passive observe-only enabled by default plus 6 opt-in blocking gates), 1 local MCP server (`trust`), and 1 optional read-only timeline sidecar UI ([`sidecars/astack_timeline/`](./sidecars/astack_timeline/sidecar.json)), plus opt-in scheduled automation templates under [`docs/automations/`](./docs/automations/beacon/README.md). It runs locally as markdown skills and zero-dependency Node.js scripts. It has no hosted backend, sends no telemetry, and pins no model, so it uses whatever model you pick in Antigravity. fork it. improve it. make it yours. PRs are welcome!

Earned trust · Install · Quick start · Plan & review · How it fits · 65 skills · User guide · Tutorials · Credits · Contributing · Security

## Why trust is the limiting step (Loops You Can Trust) An agent writes code fast. Reviewing code that nobody ran is slow. If the agent says "all tests pass" without running your app, the checking still falls on you. With AStack, you only need two commands, and [`/astack-mode`](./skills/astack-mode/SKILL.md) handles the live testing behind the scenes: ```mermaid flowchart LR Setup["`**1. Once per repo** Run /setup-astack`"] Goal["`**2. State your goal** Run /astack-mode (add /plan to review first)`"] Auto["`**3. AStack runs automatically** Reads code · Writes & cleans diff Tests your live app in browser or CLI`"] Done["`**4. Review with proof** Verified local commits + captured output`"] Setup --> Goal --> Auto --> Done classDef userStep fill:#111827,stroke:#38bdf8,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#f9fafb classDef autoStep fill:#111827,stroke:#eab308,stroke-width:2px,color:#f9fafb classDef doneStep fill:#111827,stroke:#22c55e,stroke-width:2px,color:#f9fafb class Setup,Goal userStep class Auto autoStep class Done doneStep ``` 1. **Set up once ([`/setup-astack`](./skills/setup-astack/SKILL.md)).** Teaches AStack how to start and check your project. 2. **Give a goal ([`/astack-mode`](./skills/astack-mode/SKILL.md)).** Add `/plan` in front whenever you want to approve the plan before any files change. 3. **Review the proof, not guesses.** `/astack-mode` automatically reads your codebase, writes and cleans the diff, runs your real app in the browser or terminal, and hands back captured output. AStack fits nontrivial features, root-cause bug fixes, refactors, and PR reviews. For a one-line typo fix, ask the agent directly. ## Install Requires **Google Antigravity** and **Node.js `>= 22.6`** (`22.18+` or `23.6+` for unflagged TypeScript type stripping). Install **Java** only if you run live TLC model checking through `/statechart`. Install directly from GitHub and verify plugin registration: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/jmxt3/astack agy plugin list --json ``` To install from a local clone instead, run `agy plugin install ./astack` (or `agy plugin install .` inside the repository). On Windows, if updating while Antigravity is running fails with `Access is denied`, run `agy plugin uninstall astack` first and reinstall. ## Quick start 1. **Initialize verification in your repository once** by running `/setup-astack` inside Antigravity and picking the recommended option. It inspects your project and scaffolds `.agents/skills/verify-/` so future runs know how to start and verify your app. 2. **Run a task with `/astack-mode`** by stating what you want and how to check it works: ```text /astack-mode clicking Save twice on the profile form creates duplicate records. reproduce it in the browser first, fix the root cause, and prove double-clicking saves only once. ``` 3. **Ask `/astack-help` when unsure** to get a recommended skill, reasoning, and copy-ready prompt without spending execution turns: ```text /astack-help which skill should I use to review this branch before opening a PR? ``` ## Interactive plan, review & execute workflow To approve the plan before any file changes, put `/plan` in front of `/astack-mode`: ```text /plan /astack-mode add rate limiting to the login endpoint ``` 1. The agent reads the code and writes `implementation_plan.md`. It edits no files. 2. You comment on the plan in Antigravity and click **Proceed** when it is right. 3. The agent carries out the plan and proves the result. If your idea is still rough, start with `/plan /grill-me `. The agent asks you one question at a time and then writes the plan. [Part 2 of the User Guide](./docs/user-guide.md#part-2-plan-first-workflow-write-a-plan-approve-then-execute) has more examples. ## How it fits together Most work flows through a deterministic 6-stage pipeline when you invoke [`/astack-mode`](./skills/astack-mode/SKILL.md). Stages 1, 3, 4, and 5 advance automatically (`[AUTO]`), while Stage 2 (Implementation Plan) and Stage 6 (Visual PR Review) enforce human gates (`[HUMAN GATE]`) unless a repo explicitly opts Tier 0 into auto-merge: ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph Router["/astack-mode · 6-stage deterministic pipeline rail"] direction LR S1["`1. AUTO: Clean /deslop · /no-comments`"] S5["`5. AUTO: Prove & AI Review control-ui/cli · pr-verifier`"] S6["`6. HUMAN GATE: Visual PR /review-pr · Review pane`"] S1 --> S2 --> S3 --> S4 --> S5 --> S6 end style Router fill:transparent,stroke:#eab308,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray:5 5 classDef stage fill:#111827,stroke:#38bdf8,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#f9fafb classDef gate fill:#111827,stroke:#eab308,stroke-width:2px,color:#f9fafb classDef verify fill:#111827,stroke:#22c55e,stroke-width:2px,color:#f9fafb class S1,S3,S4,S5 stage class S2,S6 gate ``` To follow that path visually inside Google Antigravity, enable the optional [`AStack Timeline`](./sidecars/astack_timeline/sidecar.json) sidecar panel under **Extensions**. It shows the 4 per-conversation stages (`/plan` with `/grill-me`, `/astack-mode` with `/interrogate`, `/review-pr`, and `open the pr`), surfaces one-time `/setup-astack` readiness conditionally per repo (a first-time onboarding card when unconfigured, or a compact `Setup ready` header toggle once configured), supports click-to-copy command chips ready to paste in chat, and exposes a once-per-session `[AStack Timeline](sidecar://astack/astack_timeline/)` chat pill when enabled. ## Skill catalog AStack ships **65 skills** (`skills/`), **4 agents** (`agents/`), **1 routing rule** (`rules/`), and **9 lifecycle hooks** (`hooks.json`): ### Orchestration & setup (3) | Skill | Purpose | |---|---| | [`/astack-mode`](./skills/astack-mode/SKILL.md) | Main entry point routing tasks across 26 playbooks, 24 principles, subagents, and Antigravity multi-agent modes | | [`/astack-help`](./skills/astack-help/SKILL.md) | Recommends the right skill and gives a copy-paste prompt without spending execution turns | | [`/setup-astack`](./skills/setup-astack/SKILL.md) | Scaffolds repo-local `verify-` verification skills, optional formal verification, and workspace `--doctor` checks |

[Build and clean the change](./docs/guide/05-build-and-clean.md): build playbooks, `/tdd`, `/deslop`, `/unslop`, and `/no-comments`. 6. [Verify and ship](./docs/guide/06-verify-and-ship.md): Control Glass verification, formal TLA+ checks, `/benchmark-checklist`, and PR shipping. 7. [Run work while you sleep](./docs/guide/07-overnight.md): `/goal` contracts, `decisions.tsv` audit logs, `/schedule`, `/automation`, Remote Agents, and Remote Control. 8. [Steer with principle names](./docs/guide/08-principles.md): redirect agents mid-task using the 24 named principles. 9. [Make it yours](./docs/guide/09-make-it-yours.md): personal `-mode` skills, `/correct`, and testing skill edits. 10. [Recipes and pitfalls](./docs/guide/10-recipes-and-pitfalls.md): ready-to-copy prompts and common anti-patterns. ## Security & lifecycle hooks AStack runs locally with zero external npm dependencies. It starts no hosted servers, sends no telemetry, and stores no credentials. When you enable the optional [`AStack Timeline`](./sidecars/astack_timeline/sidecar.json) sidecar in Antigravity, Antigravity launches one read-only localhost HTTP panel bound to `127.0.0.1` that inspects local transcripts, workspace readiness, and `astack-trust` receipts without mutating files or sending agent messages. [`hooks.json`](./hooks.json) enables three passive observe-only hooks (`astack-receipt-ledger`, `astack-session-context`, and `astack-pr-intent`) by default while keeping all six blocking gates (`astack-irreversible-guard`, `astack-verify-reminder`, `astack-secret-guard`, `astack-evidence-gate`, `astack-boundary-guard`, and `astack-round-limiter`) disabled until opted in. Dormant scheduled automation templates live under [`docs/automations/`](./docs/automations/beacon/README.md) ([PR triage](./docs/automations/pr-triage/README.md), [weekly `/correct`](./docs/automations/weekly-correct/README.md)). To report a vulnerability, follow [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md). ## Credits & license AStack adapts foundations from Lauren Tan's [`pstack`](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack), Garry Tan's [`gstack`](https://github.com/garrytan/gstack), and Cloudflare's [`security-audit-skill`](https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill). Read [CREDITS.md](./CREDITS.md) for full attribution. To contribute, read [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md), or [open an issue](https://github.com/jmxt3/astack/issues/new/choose). [João Machete](https://github.com/jmxt3) maintains AStack under the [MIT License](./LICENSE).

# AStack: Make AI agents prove their work on your running app > **Don't trust the agent. Trust the evidence.**

AStack is a Google Antigravity plugin that makes the agent prove its work. You give [`/astack-mode`](./skills/astack-mode/SKILL.md) a goal. It picks a playbook, runs the skills that playbook needs, cleans the diff, and checks the result on your running app before it reports done. AStack takes inspiration from Lauren Tan's [`pstack`](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack) for empirical verification playbooks and Garry Tan's [`gstack`](https://github.com/garrytan/gstack) for structured review gates, and builds those ideas natively for Google Antigravity. AStack has 65 skills, 26 playbooks, 24 engineering principles, 4 custom agents, 1 routing rule, 9 lifecycle hooks (3 passive observe-only enabled by default plus 6 opt-in blocking gates), 1 local MCP server (`trust`), and 1 optional read-only timeline sidecar UI ([`sidecars/astack_timeline/`](./sidecars/astack_timeline/sidecar.json)), plus opt-in scheduled automation templates under [`docs/automations/`](./docs/automations/beacon/README.md). It runs locally as markdown skills and zero-dependency Node.js scripts. It has no hosted backend, sends no telemetry, and pins no model, so it uses whatever model you pick in Antigravity. fork it. improve it. make it yours. PRs are welcome!

Earned trust · Install · Quick start · Plan & review · How it fits · 65 skills · User guide · Tutorials · Credits · Contributing · Security

## Why trust is the limiting step (Loops You Can Trust) An agent writes code fast. Reviewing code that nobody ran is slow. If the agent says "all tests pass" without running your app, the checking still falls on you. With AStack, you only need two commands, and [`/astack-mode`](./skills/astack-mode/SKILL.md) handles the live testing behind the scenes: ```mermaid flowchart LR Setup["`**1. Once per repo** Run /setup-astack`"] Goal["`**2. State your goal** Run /astack-mode (add /plan to review first)`"] Auto["`**3. AStack runs automatically** Reads code · Writes & cleans diff Tests your live app in browser or CLI`"] Done["`**4. Review with proof** Verified local commits + captured output`"] Setup --> Goal --> Auto --> Done classDef userStep fill:#111827,stroke:#38bdf8,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#f9fafb classDef autoStep fill:#111827,stroke:#eab308,stroke-width:2px,color:#f9fafb classDef doneStep fill:#111827,stroke:#22c55e,stroke-width:2px,color:#f9fafb class Setup,Goal userStep class Auto autoStep class Done doneStep ``` 1. **Set up once ([`/setup-astack`](./skills/setup-astack/SKILL.md)).** Teaches AStack how to start and check your project. 2. **Give a goal ([`/astack-mode`](./skills/astack-mode/SKILL.md)).** Add `/plan` in front whenever you want to approve the plan before any files change. 3. **Review the proof, not guesses.** `/astack-mode` automatically reads your codebase, writes and cleans the diff, runs your real app in the browser or terminal, and hands back captured output. AStack fits nontrivial features, root-cause bug fixes, refactors, and PR reviews. For a one-line typo fix, ask the agent directly. ## Install Requires **Google Antigravity** and **Node.js `>= 22.6`** (`22.18+` or `23.6+` for unflagged TypeScript type stripping). Install **Java** only if you run live TLC model checking through `/statechart`. Install directly from GitHub and verify plugin registration: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/jmxt3/astack agy plugin list --json ``` To install from a local clone instead, run `agy plugin install ./astack` (or `agy plugin install .` inside the repository). On Windows, if updating while Antigravity is running fails with `Access is denied`, run `agy plugin uninstall astack` first and reinstall. ## Quick start 1. **Initialize verification in your repository once** by running `/setup-astack` inside Antigravity and picking the recommended option. It inspects your project and scaffolds `.agents/skills/verify-/` so future runs know how to start and verify your app. 2. **Run a task with `/astack-mode`** by stating what you want and how to check it works: ```text /astack-mode clicking Save twice on the profile form creates duplicate records. reproduce it in the browser first, fix the root cause, and prove double-clicking saves only once. ``` 3. **Ask `/astack-help` when unsure** to get a recommended skill, reasoning, and copy-ready prompt without spending execution turns: ```text /astack-help which skill should I use to review this branch before opening a PR? ``` ## Interactive plan, review & execute workflow To approve the plan before any file changes, put `/plan` in front of `/astack-mode`: ```text /plan /astack-mode add rate limiting to the login endpoint ``` 1. The agent reads the code and writes `implementation_plan.md`. It edits no files. 2. You comment on the plan in Antigravity and click **Proceed** when it is right. 3. The agent carries out the plan and proves the result. If your idea is still rough, start with `/plan /grill-me `. The agent asks you one question at a time and then writes the plan. [Part 2 of the User Guide](./docs/user-guide.md#part-2-plan-first-workflow-write-a-plan-approve-then-execute) has more examples. ## How it fits together Most work flows through a deterministic 6-stage pipeline when you invoke [`/astack-mode`](./skills/astack-mode/SKILL.md). Stages 1, 3, 4, and 5 advance automatically (`[AUTO]`), while Stage 2 (Implementation Plan) and Stage 6 (Visual PR Review) enforce human gates (`[HUMAN GATE]`) unless a repo explicitly opts Tier 0 into auto-merge: ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph Router["/astack-mode · 6-stage deterministic pipeline rail"] direction LR S1["`1. AUTO: Understand /how · /why · base REVIEW.md`"] S2["`2. HUMAN GATE: Plan /plan · Proceed`"] S3["`3. AUTO: Build & Guard astack-agent · /tdd · hooks`"] S4["`4. AUTO: Clean /deslop · /no-comments`"] S5["`5. AUTO: Prove & AI Review control-ui/cli · pr-verifier`"] S6["`6. [Recipes and pitfalls](./docs/guide/10-recipes-and-pitfalls.md): ready-to-copy prompts and common anti-patterns. ## Security & lifecycle hooks AStack runs locally with zero external npm dependencies. It starts no hosted servers, sends no telemetry, and stores no credentials. When you enable the optional [`AStack Timeline`](./sidecars/astack_timeline/sidecar.json) sidecar in Antigravity, Antigravity launches one read-only localhost HTTP panel bound to `127.0.0.1` that inspects local transcripts, workspace readiness, and `astack-trust` receipts without mutating files or sending agent messages. [`hooks.json`](./hooks.json) enables three passive observe-only hooks (`astack-receipt-ledger`, `astack-session-context`, and `astack-pr-intent`) by default while keeping all six blocking gates (`astack-irreversible-guard`, `astack-verify-reminder`, `astack-secret-guard`, `astack-evidence-gate`, `astack-boundary-guard`, and `astack-round-limiter`) disabled until opted in. Dormant scheduled automation templates live under [`docs/automations/`](./docs/automations/beacon/README.md) ([PR triage](./docs/automations/pr-triage/README.md), [weekly `/correct`](./docs/automations/weekly-correct/README.md)).
